Included mirror license: ARCADE-LICENSE.txt (Kenney CC0)

Derived WAVs: mono 44100 Hz PCM 16-bit, normalized with ffmpeg loudnorm -20 LUFS/-3 dBTP. Per-weapon runtime gain, modest pitch variation, discharge envelope, mechanical and bass layers, short early reflections. manifest.json records original and converted SHA-256 and duration. No franchise audio is included. Original OGGs archived in source/.
